en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. When I was writing this strange story, I had just beaten Hua Qianxiao, and after the beating, my mind was filled with the rhythm of battle music. The key instrument of this boss battle song is the guqin, especially its sliding strings, which perfectly reproduces Hua Qianxiao's "Drunken Sword" move on the auditory level. Moreover, because it is a folk instrument, it naturally has an ancient style, or martial arts temperament. But what I find most interesting is the style of this piece. It sounds like a trap-style hip-hop beat - the guqin plays the role of a sample. You can even imagine yourself doing a freestyle on this song. This fusion of Chinese folk music and contemporary pop music techniques is the feature that impressed me most about the boss battle music of "Shadow Blade Zero".

zh.title: “Hob”是一款开源应用程序，可让您轻松免费离线使用本地AI，并且兼容Windows、Mac和Linux，并允许自动选择适合PC的AI模型、文件操作和外部应用程序联动。
zh.summary: 要在PC上运行AI，您需要选择与PC性能相匹配的AI模型并构建执行环境。不仅需要与AI聊天，还需要读取和处理手头的文件，可能需要额外的设置。 Hob 是一款自动执行这些任务的免费开源应用程序，它允许您选择适合您的 PC 的 AI 模型，构建执行环境，并通过聊天分析、编辑和创建文档和电子表格文件的图表。阅读更多...

en.title: "Hob" is an open source app that allows you to easily use local AI offline for free, and is compatible with Windows, Mac, and Linux, and allows automatic selection of AI models suitable for PC, file manipulation, and external application linkage.
en.summary: To run AI on your PC, you need to select an AI model that matches the performance of your PC and build an execution environment.Additional settings may be required not only to chat with AI but also to read and process files at hand. Hob, a free open source app that automates these tasks, is a tool that allows you to select an AI model suitable for your PC, build an execution environment, and analyze, edit, and create graphs for documents and spreadsheet files from a chat. read more...
